profile.headline: Azure Integrations Specialist
profile.summary:
An IT professional with nearly 20 years working experience ranging the gamut from IBM 3270 mainframes, COBOL and DYL280 coding, through SSIS, SSRS, PowerBI and BizTalk, and now Azure (Functions, Logic Apps, DevOps etc). I love to dig into new technologies and learn how they work.


Coming out of college with my computer science degree, I hoped to give back to my hometown company, ALFA Insurance, which had previously allowed me to earn extra money with jobs during the summer and winter breaks. In September 2003, I was offered that chance in the programming department. Three years later I would hear of an opening on the team which is at the front lines of implementing, testing and maintaining the new Exceed 1.X system which would eventually replace our prior CICS based system. I asserted myself as a leader in code maintenance as well as data fixes as we moved towards implementing the next version of Exceed C.0.

In May 2013, I had the opportunity to take a job in Atlanta where I had recently moved. I worked as a consultant, within project teams to help various clients implement Microsoft Data Services solutions. I worked with dozens of clients locally in the Atlanta area as well as across the country. This exposure to new technologies and teams fueled my growth as a Software Developer.

In April 2019, I left the young man's consulting game, and began work as a full time BizTalk developer, but quickly picked up .Net development, and have since gained a lot of knowledge and experience with regards to Azure.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description:
·       Migrated dozens of legacy integrations from BizTalk, SSIS and SQL Agent Jobs into serverless architecture using Azure Functions and Logic Apps using API calls and webhooks improving throughput and simplifying system maintenance
·       Led development of new end-to-end integrations between existing internal systems and external SAAS providers enabling our business users to bring products to market faster while minimizing manual data-entry errors
·       Developed robust backend .NET solutions leveraging OOP design patterns such as inheritance and dependency injection
·       Collaborated with developers, product managers and cross functional teams within an Agile framework to scope requirements, optimize workflows and provide visibility to stakeholders
·       Led technical support for integration issues by building dashboards and queries in Datadog, Grafana, and KQL thereby reducing customer service issues.
·       Utilized Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI tools to accelerate the development pipeline, streamline code reviews and expedite debugging
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · Microsoft Azure · Azure Logic Apps · Azure Functions · BizTalk

positions.title: Data Services Consultant
positions.description: Innovative Architects is now Improving! As of January 2019, we’re now a part of the Improving - Atlanta office.

positions.title: Data Services Consultant
positions.description:
Worked with various clients and teams across the US with regional, national, and international reach.
Implemented various SSIS processes.
Written, optimized and debugged various stored procedures and SSRS reports.
Translated SQL Server stored procedures to execute on Netezza.
Maintained and updated scripts and reports for a school district database.
Upgraded Biztalk interfaces, schemas, orchestrations etc. from Biztalk 2010 to 2013.
Developed Biztalk solution to load EDI 837 file to Database
positions.insights: Skills: SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · BizTalk

positions.title: Secretary of the Board of Directors
positions.description:
Taking minutes of board meetings.
Working with the rest of the board to help grow and support the school.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst II (Exceed Admin Team)
positions.description: In charge of keeping track of all code delivered from CSC for the new Exceed C.0 platform as well as our current 1.X platform. Code is moved through Endevor between the test environments for testing, and eventually load to the production environment. Also in charge of receiving, preparing and executing datafixes delivered from CSC to correct corrupted policies. Other responsibilities include: Finding, researching and reporting errors in production and test environments of Exceed. Writing DB2 queries regularly to get information for other departments. Assisting in building new CICS environments as needed for testing.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst I (Claims Team)
positions.description: Created, maintained and debugged COBOL and DYL280 programs. Worked with VSAM files and DB2 as well. Mainly dealt with legacy reporting programs for Claims and Accounting departments. Also worked on updating interface programs for the new Exceed 1.X system being implemented.

positions.title: Life New Business Coder
positions.description: Entered Life Insurance New Business applications into the AS/400 system. Also continued previous work with the Life DBO offer.

positions.title: Podcast Co-Host
positions.description: Co-Hosted M.C. Wilson's gaming podcast Broadcast Gamer. We discussed current news in the video gaming industry.

positions.title: Life DBO Specialist (Summer Help)
positions.description: Worked with a group on the first Life DBO offer extended by the company. We keyed applications into the AS/400 system and kept track of statistics regarding the offer.

positions.title: Building Maintenance (Winter Help)
positions.description: Swept and organized basement and supply areas. Moved old office furniture to offsite storage. Performed other various cleaning tasks.

positions.title: Microfilm Clerk (Summer Help)
positions.description: Sorted incoming mail for delivery to members of the Life Department. Scanned policies onto microfilm. Found and delivered policies (on microfilm or in folders) when requested by users in the department. Sorted folders of policy information and microfilm when they were returned to our area.

positions.title: Foy Student Union Rec Room Consultant
positions.description: Met with the director of Foy Student Union a few times to discuss improvements to increase traffic to the Rec Room as well as improving its ambiance for the regular visitors. Included were discussions on lighting, paint, restoration of current games, and suggestions for replacing or adding games.

positions.title: Grounds Maintenance (Summer Help)
positions.description: Worked in general grounds maintenance and beautification. Mowed lawns, picked weeds, placed pine straw. Loaded and drove trailers with lawn equipment. Removed rust stains from exterior of building. Also rendered various other help as requested by supervisor.
